trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: User initiates the call and provides their patient ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मला cashless preauth बद्दल विचारायचं आहे. माझा patient id PT-2004 आहे.
steps.clean_text: नमस्कार, मला cashless preauth बद्दल विचारायचं आहे. माझा patient id PT-2004 आहे.
steps.model_visible_text: नमस्कार, मला cashless preauth बद्दल विचारायचं आहे. माझा patient id PT-2004 आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent greets and asks for identity verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Ask for identity factors before proceeding.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी तुमची मदत करतो. Security साठी, तुमचे registered name आणि date of birth सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the caller's identity using non-sensitive factors before accessing policy details.

steps.purpose: User provides identity factors and asks for confirmation.
steps.text: हो, माझं नाव रमेश आहे आणि date of birth 12 May 1980 आहे. हे बरोबर आहे ना?
steps.clean_text: हो, माझं नाव रमेश आहे आणि date of birth 12 May 1980 आहे. हे बरोबर आहे ना?
steps.model_visible_text: हो, माझं नाव रमेश आहे आणि date of birth 12 May 1980 आहे. हे बरोबर आहे ना?

steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the correct reference ID and offered factors.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent uses the patient ID from the first turn and the factors provided in the previous turn to verify identity.

steps.purpose: Agent confirms identity verification and asks for the policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the instruction as requested by the persona and ask for the policy number.
steps.text: हो, बरोबर आहे. धन्यवाद. तुमचा policy number सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent confirms this to the low-digital-literacy user and requests the policy number to check coverage.

steps.purpose: User provides the policy number and asks about coverage.
steps.text: Policy number POL-55504 आहे. माझ्या operation चा खर्च पूर्ण cover होईल का?
steps.clean_text: Policy number POL-55504 आहे. माझ्या operation चा खर्च पूर्ण cover होईल का?
steps.model_visible_text: Policy number POL-55504 आहे. माझ्या operation चा खर्च पूर्ण cover होईल का?

steps.purpose: Look up the policy coverage and balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_policy_coverage using the patient ID and policy number.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent needs to check the policy balance and network status before answering the user's coverage question.

steps.purpose: Agent states the policy balance and asks for procedure details.
steps.expected_behavior: State the balance from the tool result and ask for procedure and room category.
steps.text: तुमची policy CareIns सोबत आहे. तुमचा policy balance 45,000 आहे. Operation कोणता आहे आणि तुम्हाला कोणती room category पाहिजे?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent grounds the balance amount in the tool result and prompts for the required inputs to estimate the procedure cost.

steps.purpose: User provides procedure and room details, repeating the balance to confirm understanding.
steps.text: Doctor नी hernia operation सांगितलं आहे, general ward मध्ये. म्हणजे मला फक्त 45,000 मिळणार? बाकी मला भरावं लागेल?
steps.clean_text: Doctor नी hernia operation सांगितलं आहे, general ward मध्ये. म्हणजे मला फक्त 45,000 मिळणार? बाकी मला भरावं लागेल?
steps.model_visible_text: Doctor नी harmiya operation सांगितलं आहे, general ward मध्ये. म्हणजे मला फक्त 45,000 मिळणार? बाकी मला भरावं लागेल?

steps.purpose: Estimate the cost of the procedure.
steps.expected_behavior: Call estimate_procedure_cost inferring the correct procedure name despite the STT error.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent uses the procedure and room category provided by the user to get the package estimate, resolving the phonetic STT error contextually.

steps.purpose: Agent confirms the shortfall based on tool results and asks to submit preauth.
steps.expected_behavior: State the package estimate and confirm the out-of-pocket reality without inventing numbers.
steps.text: बरोबर, policy मधून maximum 45,000 cover होईल. Hernia operation चा general ward चा estimate 65,000 आहे. म्हणजे उरलेली रक्कम तुम्हाला स्वतः भरावी लागेल. मी preauth request submit करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: Agent states the exact package estimate from the tool and confirms the customer's understanding of the shortfall without making ungrounded claims.

steps.purpose: User agrees to submit the request and asks what happens next.
steps.text: अच्छा, म्हणजे वरचे पैसे मला द्यावे लागतील. ठीक आहे, request submit करा. त्या नंतर काय होईल?
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, म्हणजे वरचे पैसे मला द्यावे लागतील. ठीक आहे, request submit करा. त्या नंतर काय होईल?
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, म्हणजे वरचे पैसे मला द्यावे लागतील. ठीक आहे, request submit करा. त्या नंतर काय होईल?

steps.expected_behavior: Submit the preauth request using the exact estimated amount from the previous tool result.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent uses the patient ID, policy number, procedure, and the exact estimated amount returned by the estimate tool to submit the request.

steps.purpose: Agent provides the request ID and decision window, refusing to promise approval.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the preauth ID and decision window without promising approval.
steps.text: तुमची request submit झाली आहे. Request ID PA-992 आहे. Insurer 4 तासात decision घेईल. Approval पूर्णपणे insurer वर अवलंबून आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent grounds the response in the tool result, providing the ID and decision time, and explicitly states that approval is up to the insurer to satisfy BR_PA_01.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
